title: Acceptance criteria wait for a written task
description: Use private GATEWAY_PORT/VITE_PORT, owned headless FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT, FARMSLOT_LAYOUT_EVIDENCE and ffmpeg. The observed-WebSocket fixture drives the mounted run page. No actual gateway, task writer, native host or worker is started. An archived FARMSLOT_LAYOUT_UI_ROOT with FARMSLOT_LAYOUT_EXPECT_SHIFT=1 reproduces the old false error.

prove.intent: Before a task file exists, require no AC panel and no task.progress read while write-task runs. Publish the written task through fixture snapshots and require the criterion to arrive in the held row without changing the pipeline height. Keep a real ledger read error visible after the task exists, then recover; a task without criteria leaves no row; a run opened after its task exists holds no row while its first read loads. Record 1280px; the next nodes own distinct 414px and slot-free review runs.

result.intent: Require all mounted protocol/presentation assertions and scoped teardown.

prove414.intent: Repeat with a distinct fresh 414px run lifecycle; no written task is rewound.

result414.intent: Require all mounted protocol/presentation assertions and scoped teardown.

proveReview.intent: Repeat for a slot-free review: its workspace exists before write-task records the task file, and nothing is read or shown until it does.

resultReview.intent: Require all mounted protocol/presentation assertions and scoped teardown.
